instruction.text: Select the boat to find out more.

feedback.end: This is the Titanic. It is famous for sinking on its first ever journey.

atoms.b: The Titanic was built in Belfast. It took ((++3_years 1_day)) to finish constructing it.
((++15,000 3)) people worked to build the Titanic.
When it set sail in April 1912, it was the ((++biggest smallest)) ship ever made!

instruction.text: Drag the bar of soap to the ramp.

feedback.finish: Workers used 22 tonnes of soap to help the Titanic slide down the ramp and into the water — that’s about as heavy as a double-decker bus full of people!

atoms.text: Nearly 100,000 people gathered to watch the Titanic set sail from Belfast, where it was built, to Southampton.

instruction.text: What do you think it would have been like to see the Titanic in real life?

feedback.finish: The Titanic was a huge deal because of how large and luxurious it was. It was also famous for being called unsinkable by the people who built it.

instruction.text: The Titanic was then meant to sail from Southampton to New York. Draw a line along the path that the Titanic was meant to take.
